name: herbig-group-website
description: Herbig Group website. Plain static HTML/CSS/JS; stamp.js is the only build step. The inquiry function has NO dependencies and the build runs no npm install - a failed install would take the live site down, and this environment cannot reach the npm registry to verify one. Note: there is deliberately no "type": "module" here. stamp.js is CommonJS and has been the build command since Phase 4; declaring the package as ESM made `node stamp.js` fail with "require is not defined", which would have broken every deploy. The function and contract files are .mjs, so they are ESM regardless of this setting.
